head: ChartMe chore chart app for kids: points, streaks and rewards
dek: ChartMe is a new family chore chart for iPhone and iPad where kids tick off chores on their own device, earn points and spend them on rewards parents set up. It was #74 in Productivity on the US App Store's paid chart on November 14.
details: Chores can repeat daily, weekly or at each meal, and rotations share jobs like dishes turn by turn. Kids get streaks, a weekly leaderboard that resets on Monday and a store for rewards. Parents can require approval for a chore, adjust points or excuse time off without breaking a streak, and the family stays in sync through iCloud. It costs 3.99 dollars, is made by 32pixels and came out on November 12.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, 3.99 dollars
means: If you run chores on a paper chart or in a group chat, this moves the whole system onto your kids' own iPhones or iPads.
todo: Each kid needs their own iPhone or iPad to check off chores, so make sure that fits your family before you buy.
